subject.title: [Feature]: Support direct video upload to LLM

question: Should OpenClaw add provider-native video as a first-class chat/model input, and if so what core/plugin contract, security limits, and fallback behavior should own it?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent API shape crosses product UX, provider routing, raw-media egress, plugin/core ownership, and fallback policy that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve first-class video input
options.body: Define a coherent WebChat/Gateway/model-catalog/provider contract with size, retention, egress, and fallback rules before landing an implementation.

options.title: Keep video in media-understanding
options.body: Defer direct chat/model video uploads and document the supported video.description media-understanding path instead.

options.title: Prove provider-specific plugins first
options.body: Let provider-owned video behavior mature behind existing media-understanding/plugin seams before adding generic chat-video content types.

recommendation.title: Approve first-class video input
recommendation.body: Define a coherent WebChat/Gateway/model-catalog/provider contract with size, retention, egress, and fallback rules before landing an implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest visible routing context plus broad adjacent media/provider history among the likely owners.
